options.content: Choose **mini/chungus/lapdog**, even if never scraped. Unknown resources are not zero. Current stats require a successful node and relevant collector scrape. Systemd is the node collector (not separate systemd_exporter). Disk I/O is whole-device; network is physical interfaces plus Tailscale. GPU section explicitly stays Chungus-only. Dashboard shows infrastructure, not end-to-end application availability.

targets.expr: (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) or on(host) (label_replace(vector(0), "host", "$host", "", ""))) + on(host) (count by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) or on(host) (label_replace(vector(0), "host", "$host", "", "")))

(time() - node_boot_time_seconds{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="stat"}) == 1)

(node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector=~"cpu|meminfo|loadavg|filesystem|diskstats|netdev|systemd|stat"}) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1)

panels.title: Resources · gaps are unknown, not zero
CPU busy
panels.description: Idle counter rate across logical CPUs; up and cpu collector gated.

targets.expr: (100 * (1 - avg by(host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])))) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="cpu"}) == 1)

(100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"})) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="meminfo"}) == 1)

panels.title: Swap used / total
panels.description: No swap configured => Unknown/not applicable, not 0%.

targets.expr: (100 * (1 - node_memory_SwapFree_bytes{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"} / node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) and (node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"} > 0)) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="meminfo"}) == 1)

panels.title: Load 1m / logical CPU
panels.description: Load is a gauge; 1 means one runnable/blocked task per logical CPU.

targets.expr: ((node_load1{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"} / on(host) group_left count by(host) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",mode="idle"})) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="loadavg"}) == 1)) and on(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="cpu"} == 1)

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Per interface; bridges, veth and loopback excluded. Tailscale/physical traffic can overlap; do not sum.

targets.expr: (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",device=~"en.*|eth.*|wl.*|tailscale0"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="netdev"}) == 1)

(rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",device=~"en.*|eth.*|wl.*|tailscale0"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="netdev"}) == 1)

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Whole devices only, not partitions. Counter rates; do not sum device and partition metrics.

targets.expr: (rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",device=~"nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|sd[a-z]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="diskstats"}) == 1)

(rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",device=~"nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|sd[a-z]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="diskstats"}) == 1)

(100 * rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",device=~"nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|sd[a-z]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="diskstats"}) == 1)

(rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",device=~"en.*|eth.*|wl.*|tailscale0"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="netdev"}) == 1)

(rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",device=~"en.*|eth.*|wl.*|tailscale0"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="netdev"}) == 1)

(rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",device=~"en.*|eth.*|wl.*|tailscale0"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="netdev"}) == 1)

(rate(node_network_transmit_drop_total{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",device=~"en.*|eth.*|wl.*|tailscale0"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="netdev"}) == 1)

panels.title: Failed services (all service units)
panels.description: Zero means observed healthy. Unknown means node/systemd collection failed. Does not include user-manager/Podman user units.

targets.expr: (sum by(host) (node_systemd_unit_state{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",name=~".+\\.service",state="failed"})) and on(host) (max by(host) (up{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}"}) == 1) and on(host) (max by(host) (node_scrape_collector_success{job="node",host=~"${host:regex}",collector="systemd"}) == 1)

panels.title: Failed service identities
panels.description: Empty is normal when no failures; check the count/collector before interpreting emptiness.
